description:
Title: Find a Job

You have to regularly report, to which companies you wrote job applications.
Based on your job applications, new potential job offers are sent to you.
Companies have to confirm that they received job applications and rate the application.
A job interview can be negotiated.
When a company wants you to work for them, you enter the probation phase.
After probation phase, you can rate the company and the company can rate you.
Reviews for a company can only be seen (by job applicants) after 1 year.
If a job becomes permanent, the process ends, unless you rated the company C or less, then you continue to receive job offers, but no longer have to report.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_FindJob" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/find-a-job">

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FindJob" name="Find a Job">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Job applicant" processRef="Process_Applicant"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_Company"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Application" name="Job application" sourceRef="Task_SendApp" targetRef="Start_AppReceived" messageRef="Msg_Application"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Confirmation" name="Application receipt confirmed" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmReceipt" targetRef="Catch_Confirm" messageRef="Msg_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ApplicationRating" name="Application rated" sourceRef="Task_RateApp" targetRef="Catch_Rating" messageRef="Msg_ApplicationRating"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_InterviewRequest" name="Job interview negotiation" sourceRef="Task_RequestInterview" targetRef="Catch_InterviewReq" messageRef="Msg_InterviewRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_EmploymentOffer" name="Employment offer" sourceRef="Task_OfferEmployment" targetRef="Catch_EmpOffer" messageRef="Msg_EmploymentOffer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ProbationDone" name="Probation completed" sourceRef="Task_NotifyProbation" targetRef="Catch_ProbationDone" messageRef="Msg_ProbationDone"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_CompanyRating" name="Company rates applicant" sourceRef="Task_RateApplicant" targetRef="Catch_CompanyRates" messageRef="Msg_CompanyRating"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_JobPermanent" name="Job becomes permanent" sourceRef="Task_MakePermanent" targetRef="Catch_Permanent" messageRef="Msg_JobPermanent"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Application" name="Job application"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Confirmation" name="Application receipt confirmed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ApplicationRating" name="Application rated"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_InterviewRequest" name="Job interview negotiation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_EmploymentOffer" name="Employment offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ProbationDone" name="Probation completed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_CompanyRating" name="Company rates applicant"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_JobPermanent" name="Job becomes permanent"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_JobOffer" name="New job offer"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Applicant" name="Find a Job - Applicant" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_JobSearch" name="Job search started"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Merge_Cycle" name="Start of reporting cycle"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_WriteApp" name="Write job application"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendApp" name="Send job application" messageRef="Msg_Application"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReportApp" name="Report application to companies"/>

    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_Wait" name="Next event"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Confirm" name="Application receipt confirmed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Confirm" messageRef="Msg_Confirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Rating" name="Application rated">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Rating" messageRef="Msg_ApplicationRating"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_InterviewReq" name="Job interview requested">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_InterviewReq" messageRef="Msg_InterviewRequest"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Negotiate" name="Negotiate job interview"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_JobOffer" name="New job offer received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_JobOffer" messageRef="Msg_JobOffer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_EmpOffer" name="Employment offer received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_EmpOffer" messageRef="Msg_EmploymentOffer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Loop" name="Continue reporting cycle"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Probation" name="Probation phase">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Probation" name="Probation started"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_WorkProbation" name="Work probation period"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Probation" name="Probation phase ended"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProbationStart" sourceRef="StartEvent_Probation" targetRef="Task_WorkProbation"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProbationEnd" sourceRef="Task_WorkProbation" targetRef="End_Probation"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyProbation" name="Notify company probation completed" messageRef="Msg_ProbationDone"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RateSplit" name="Start rating"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RateCompany" name="Rate company"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_CompanyRates" name="Company rates applicant">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CompanyRates" messageRef="Msg_CompanyRating"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Timer_OneYear" name="One year elapsed">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_OneYear">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P1Y</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ViewReviews" name="View company reviews"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ReviewsVisible" name="Company reviews visible"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RateJoin" name="Ratings exchanged"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Permanent" name="Job becomes permanent">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Permanent" messageRef="Msg_JobPermanent"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Permanent" name="Company rated C or less?" default="Flow_PermanentEnd"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_JobPermanent" name="Job permanent, process ends"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OfferMerge" name="Continue receiving job offers"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_JobOffer2" name="New job offer received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_JobOffer2" messageRef="Msg_JobOffer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OfferCheck" name="Keep receiving job offers?" default="Flow_OfferEnd"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OffersStopped" name="Job offer receipt ended"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start" sourceRef="StartEvent_JobSearch" targetRef="Merge_Cycle"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WriteApp" sourceRef="Merge_Cycle" targetRef="Task_WriteApp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WriteSend" sourceRef="Task_WriteApp" targetRef="Task_SendApp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendReport" sourceRef="Task_SendApp" targetRef="Task_ReportApp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReportWait" sourceRef="Task_ReportApp" targetRef="Gateway_Wait"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitConfirm" sourceRef="Gateway_Wait" targetRef="Catch_Confirm"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitInterview" sourceRef="Gateway_Wait" targetRef="Catch_InterviewReq"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitJobOffer" sourceRef="Gateway_Wait" targetRef="Catch_JobOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitEmpOffer" sourceRef="Gateway_Wait" targetRef="Catch_EmpOffer"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConfirmRating" sourceRef="Catch_Confirm" targetRef="Catch_Rating"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RatingLoop" sourceRef="Catch_Rating" targetRef="Gateway_Loop"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewNegotiate" sourceRef="Catch_InterviewReq" targetRef="Task_Negotiate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NegotiateLoop" sourceRef="Task_Negotiate" targetRef="Gateway_Loop"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JobOfferLoop" sourceRef="Catch_JobOffer" targetRef="Gateway_Loop"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoopRestart" sourceRef="Gateway_Loop" targetRef="Merge_Cycle"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmpProbation" sourceRef="Catch_EmpOffer" targetRef="SubProcess_Probation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProbationNotify" sourceRef="SubProcess_Probation" targetRef="Task_NotifyProbation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifyRate" sourceRef="Task_NotifyProbation" targetRef="Gateway_RateSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitRate" sourceRef="Gateway_RateSplit" targetRef="Task_RateCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitCompanyRates" sourceRef="Gateway_RateSplit" targetRef="Catch_CompanyRates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitTimer" sourceRef="Gateway_RateSplit" targetRef="Timer_OneYear"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RateJoin" sourceRef="Task_RateCompany" targetRef="Gateway_RateJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyRatesJoin" sourceRef="Catch_CompanyRates" targetRef="Gateway_RateJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TimerReviews" sourceRef="Timer_OneYear" targetRef="Task_ViewReviews"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewsEnd" sourceRef="Task_ViewReviews" targetRef="End_ReviewsVisible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinPermanent" sourceRef="Gateway_RateJoin" targetRef="Catch_Permanent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PermanentDecision" sourceRef="Catch_Permanent" targetRef="Gateway_Permanent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PermanentContinue" name="Rated C or less" sourceRef="Gateway_Permanent" targetRef="Gateway_OfferMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${companyRatingIsCOrLess}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PermanentEnd" name="Otherwise" sourceRef="Gateway_Permanent" targetRef="End_JobPermanent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OfferMergeWait" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferMerge" targetRef="Catch_JobOffer2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OfferCheck" sourceRef="Catch_JobOffer2" targetRef="Gateway_OfferCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OfferLoopBack" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferCheck" targetRef="Gateway_OfferMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${keepReceivingOffers}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OfferEnd" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferCheck" targetRef="End_OffersStopped"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Company" name="Find a Job - Company" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_AppReceived" name="Job application received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_AppReceived" messageRef="Msg_Application"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ConfirmReceipt" name="Confirm application receipt" messageRef="Msg_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RateApp" name="Rate application" messageRef="Msg_ApplicationRating"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewSplit" name="Interview negotiated?" default="Flow_NoInterview"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RequestInterview" name="Negotiate job interview" messageRef="Msg_InterviewRequest"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewMerge" name="Interview step done"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Hire" name="Company wants applicant to work?" default="Flow_NotHired"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_OfferEmployment" name="Send employment offer" messageRef="Msg_EmploymentOffer"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ProbationDone" name="Probation completed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ProbationDone" messageRef="Msg_ProbationDone"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RateApplicant" name="Rate applicant" messageRef="Msg_CompanyRating"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_MakePermanent" name="Make job permanent" messageRef="Msg_JobPermanent"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Hired" name="Employment process ended"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotHired" name="No employment offer"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyConfirm" sourceRef="Start_AppReceived" targetRef="Task_ConfirmReceipt"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyRate" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmReceipt" targetRef="Task_RateApp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyInterviewSplit" sourceRef="Task_RateApp" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewSplit" targetRef="Task_RequestInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${interviewNegotiated}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoInterview" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewSplit" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewDone" sourceRef="Task_RequestInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewToHire" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge" targetRef="Gateway_Hire"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Hire" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Hire" targetRef="Task_OfferEmployment">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${companyWantsApplicant}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotHired" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Hire" targetRef="End_NotHired"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OfferProbation" sourceRef="Task_OfferEmployment" targetRef="Catch_ProbationDone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProbationRateApplicant" sourceRef="Catch_ProbationDone" targetRef="Task_RateApplicant"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RateApplicantPermanent" sourceRef="Task_RateApplicant" targetRef="Task_MakePermanent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PermanentEndCompany" sourceRef="Task_MakePermanent" targetRef="End_Hired"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
